risk_selection_details.selection_rule: training-time leave-one-known-attack boundary hard-negative pairwise-ranking risk learning; require positive four-metric mean gains and worst fold-metric gain >= -0.050000, otherwise fall back to the frozen reference

pseudo_unknown_learned_blend.selection_rule: leave-one-known-attack cross-fitted tail-weighted monotone pairwise head; jointly select tail gamma and reference shrinkage by worst oriented mean gain over AUROC, AUPR, FPR95 and OSCR
pseudo_unknown_learned_blend.pseudo_unknown_source: known validation attack labels plus known-only boundary interpolation

evidence_package.decision_rule: reject when selected risk exceeds the known-validation threshold
